title: A New Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: The last page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly with warmth, Chen Nian's figure flickering in and out of the prophecy—Chapter 600, the complete Tianji Record is about to appear, and Chen Ji's ultimate fate is quietly being locked in at this very moment.

text.content: The wind in Qingyun Gorge was colder than Chen Ji remembered. The moment he stepped into the gorge, the sky suddenly darkened, clouds roiling like boiling water, as if even the Heavenly Dao had bared its fangs at this moment. The blood-stained jade pendant swayed gently between Ling Yuan's fingers, and Chen Ji knew that his carefully crafted seven-year persona as a废物 had collapsed in an instant. Yet the corner of his lips curved into a faint smile.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... no, perhaps I should call you Xuanjizi. Seven years of humble endurance—this kind of patience, even an old man like myself cannot match.

text.content: Ling Yuan's voice echoed through the valley, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect standing with hands clasped behind his back, his eyes a mixture of killing intent and wariness. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, shedding his cowardly and humble mask to reveal eyes as clear and profound as an abyss. "Elder Ling, you're too kind." His voice remained calm. "I simply... grew tired of being a废物."

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing, the Demon Path Saint, appears above the demonic army with dark energy surging) Xuanjizi? Interesting... Chen Ji, this Saint's eyes did not misjudge you.

text.content: Just as the three forces faced off with swords drawn, a cold female voice descended from the clouds: "The Demon Path commander arrives in person, the Tianqing Sect Master arrives in person... Today, Qingyun Gorge is quite lively." Su Qingyao stood in mid-air, the pressure of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow pouring down, yet her gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment—containing three parts curiosity, three parts annoyance, three parts... relief.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji—Xuanjizi. I investigated you for three years, countless times thinking you were a废物, countless times feeling something was off. Turns out, my intuition never deceived me.

text.content: Chen Ji met her gaze and clasped his hands in salute: "Senior Sister Su, your relentless pursuit over three years, Chen is deeply grateful. If it weren't for your constant pressure, I wouldn't have known when I would find the resolve to awaken." These words were heart-piercing—clearly Chen Ji had manipulated every one of Su Qingyao's investigations, yet he shifted the responsibility cleanly.

choice.prompt: Identity exposed, three forces gathered. Chen Ji faces his first choice: declare war directly with his new identity, or continue to hide and scheme?

choices.text: Declare War Directly, Establish Prestige Across the World
choices.description: While the three forces confront each other, reveal all trump cards, immediately announce the establishment of "Niming Alliance," and use thunderous methods to intimidate the riffraff.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing all strength may attract more powerful enemies
choices.visible_reward: Reputation surges greatly, Niming Alliance officially establishes its name
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Eye may gaze upon it earlier

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked around, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Since all of you are here, Chen will no longer hide his talents—from today, the Niming Alliance is officially established!"

text.content: Before his words finished, the Tianji Record Fragment floated manifest behind him, ancient runes illuminating the heavens. At this moment, whether Ling Yuan or Ye Qing, their expressions changed—they finally realized that this "废物" was no longer someone they could easily manipulate.

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择直接宣战，震惊全场

choices.text: Scheme Secretly in the Dark, Accumulate Strength
choices.description: Using the Xuanjizi identity, temporarily hide in the shadows, only revealing identity to allies, steadily develop Niming Alliance's power.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to establish prestige, limited initial resources
choices.visible_reward: Hide strength, later create a bigger reversal
choices.risk_hint: May cause dissatisfaction among internal allies

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed: "With seniors present, this junior has only just entered the Dao, how would I dare show off my meager abilities? Regarding today's matter, please allow this junior to take his leave first."

text.content: Ling Yuan coldly snorted, about to strike, but saw Ye Qing's demonic army watching eagerly. He had to divide his attention for vigilance, and in that gap, Chen Ji had vanished like a specter in the mist.

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择暗中布局，暂时隐忍

dialogue.content: Want to leave? On Tianqing Sect's territory, how can you come and go as you please? Ling Yuan waved his sleeve, a磅礴 sword energy directly targeting Chen Ji—

text.content: The sword energy pierced through the air, yet Chen Ji stood motionless. Just as everyone thought he was doomed to die, a pitch-black flag unfurled from the void, completely devouring that sword energy. "Elder Ling, such fiery temper." Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of languor. "This Saint's person, you dare touch?" The Demon Path and Tianqing Sect formed a bizarre standoff at this moment.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took the chance to escape, but didn't go far. He stood in the clouds, overlooking the three-way chaos below, a playful arc curving at the corner of his mouth. "Let them fight first." He murmured. "Opportunities to fish in troubled waters arise from chaos."

choice.prompt: During the three-way battle, Chen Ji needs to make a crucial decision: take advantage of the chaos to leave and gather core members of Niming Alliance, or stay to observe the enemies' trump cards?

choices.description: Take advantage of the chaotic cover, quickly contact core allies like Ye Qing and Su Qingyao to discuss Niming Alliance establishment details.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to observe enemy trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may not easily trust

text.content: Half an hour later, in a hidden cave outside Qingyun Gorge, Chen Ji sat face-to-face with Ye Qing and Su Qingyao as equals for the first time. By flickering lamplight, Chen Ji unfurled a map: "The Niming Alliance is officially established today."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared at him, her emotions complex: "You hid too deep. But since we've come this far... I'll walk this path with you to the end."

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择召集核心，逆命盟成型

choices.text: Stay to Observe Enemies' Trump Cards
choices.description: Continue to lurk and observe, recording the true combat power of Ling Yuan, Ye Qing, and possibly appearing imperial court forces.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate Value to maintain concealment
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, providing basis for future scheming

text.content: Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, concealing his aura within the clouds. He saw Ling Yuan and Ye Qing each displaying divine abilities, yet both held back thirty percent—both were probing each other's bottom line. More importantly, he noticed from the imperial court's direction a faint, intangible divine sense watching this way.

dialogue.content: The imperial court sent someone too? Interesting... it seems news of the Emperor's disappearance can't be hidden anymore.

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择观察，获得重要情报

text.content: The chaos lasted about the time for a stick of incense, with all three sides sustaining casualties, yet none could overcome the other. Ling Yuan first withdrew, coldly scanning the entire scene: "Today's matter, this old man has noted it. Xuanjizi, you'd better pray you can hide forever." With that, the former Sect Master swept his sleeves and departed, vanishing into the depths of the cloud sea.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing gathers the demonic army, finds Chen Ji alone) Chen Ji, I've learned some news about your sister Chen Nian. She was taken by the Holy Sect to a place called "Heavenly Fate Forbidden Grounds"... that place, even this Saint dares not enter lightly.

text.content: Hearing his sister's name, an uncommon flicker crossed Chen Ji's eyes. He drew a deep breath, pressing down that emotion, his voice反而 more calm: "Heavenly Fate Forbidden Grounds... I understand. Thank you." Ye Qing saw for the first time this man reveal true emotion, her heart stirring slightly, yet she said nothing more.

choice.prompt: News of sister Chen Nian arrives, Chen Ji needs to decide the next move: immediately prepare to rescue his sister, or first consolidate Niming Alliance before planning gradually?

choices.text: Immediately Prepare to Rescue Chen Nian
choices.description: Chen Nian is Chen Ji's only relative—no matter how dangerous the Heavenly Fate Forbidden Grounds, he must venture there. Immediately gather Ye Qing and others to discuss the rescue plan.
choices.visible_cost: Niming Alliance is newly established with unstable foundations—rushed action carries enormous risk
choices.visible_reward: May rescue Chen Nian, obtaining key "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" power
choices.risk_hint: May fall into Holy Sect trap

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fist, knuckles white: "Chen Nian has been missing for seven years—I've waited long enough." He looked at Ye Qing. "How much intelligence do you have on the Heavenly Fate Forbidden Grounds?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing slightly frowned: "I only know the entrance is in the extreme cold lands of the Northern Domain. The internal structure is completely unknown. But... I can take you to meet someone who may know more."

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择救援妹妹，开启新主线

choices.text: First Consolidate Niming Alliance Before Rescuing People
choices.description: Chen Nian has been trapped for seven years and can wait a bit longer. First expand Niming Alliance's strength, create a safer rescue route.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may face greater dangers in the forbidden grounds
choices.visible_reward: Niming Alliance strength greatly increases, rescue success rate improves
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal rescue opportunity

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the turbulent emotions in his heart. When he opened them again, those eyes had returned to their usual calm: "Chen Nian... I will definitely rescue her. But not now."

text.content: He turned to Ye Qing and Su Qingyao: "What matters most right now is to take advantage of the imperial court's chaos and sects being too busy to attend to their own affairs, to spread the name of Niming Alliance. In chaotic times, only strength is the capital for speaking."

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择稳健路线，逆命盟壮大

text.content: At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated intensely, a line of blurry text emerging: "Chapter 700... Death Prophecy..." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. The Tianji Record had never revealed such a distant future in advance—unless... that ending was already fixed. He stared at that line of text for a long while, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Chapter 700? Chen Ji would like to see if this fate's script can be changed."

dialogue.content: (From the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice echoes幽幽) Young Master, the death prophecy is not unchangeable. But the price of changing fate... can you bear it?

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, gazing toward the roiling cloud sea in the distance. The Emperor of the imperial court was missing, the princes fighting desperately; the demonic army pressed at the border, Tianqing Sect facing internal and external troubles; Ling Yuan watched covetously, the Heavenly Eye gazing from the shadows... The chessboard of chaos had been laid out, and he—Xuanjizi—was officially entering the game. "Let's go." He said to Ye Qing and Su Qingyao beside him. "To announce the birth of Niming Alliance." At the horizon, the first rays of dawn pierced through the dark clouds. A new day, a new chess game.
